### ==================================================

### METADATA ANALYSIS

### Dataset: China Cleantech Export Data - Solar PV

### Format: rmd

### ==================================================

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# STEP 1: Load packages
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
# STEP 2: Import Excel file

file <- "data/712clean_tech_exports_full_release_monthly.xlsx"

# Check if file exists
file.exists(file)

# Check worksheet names
excel_sheets(file)
```


```{r}
# STEP 3: Read data
all_tech <- read_excel(file, sheet = "All technologies")
solar_pv <- read_excel(file, sheet = "Solar PV")
```

```{r}
# STEP 4: Basic metadata

# Number of observations and variables
dim(all_tech)
dim(solar_pv)

# Variable names
names(all_tech)
names(solar_pv)

# Data structure
str(all_tech)
str(solar_pv)

# Preview
head(all_tech)
head(solar_pv)

```

```{r}
# STEP 5: Geographic coverage

# Unique geographic areas
n_distinct(all_tech$Area)
n_distinct(solar_pv$Area)

# Geographic regions
unique(all_tech$Region)
unique(solar_pv$Region)

# Geographic units per region
all_tech %>%
  distinct(Area, Region) %>%
  count(Region)

solar_pv %>%
  distinct(Area, Region) %>%
  count(Region)

```

```{r}
# STEP 6: Temporal coverage

range(all_tech$Date, na.rm = TRUE)
range(solar_pv$Date, na.rm = TRUE)

# Number of unique months
n_distinct(all_tech$Date)
n_distinct(solar_pv$Date)
```

```{r}
# STEP 7: Missing values

colSums(is.na(all_tech))
colSums(is.na(solar_pv))

```

```{r}
# STEP 8: Commodity categories

unique(all_tech$`Commodity category`)
unique(solar_pv$`Commodity category`)
```

```{r}
# STEP 9: Compare worksheets

comparison <- data.frame(
  Sheet = c("All technologies", "Solar PV"),
  Observations = c(nrow(all_tech), nrow(solar_pv)),
  Variables = c(ncol(all_tech), ncol(solar_pv)),
  Geographic_Areas = c(
    n_distinct(all_tech$Area),
    n_distinct(solar_pv$Area)
  ),
  Missing_Values = c(
    sum(is.na(all_tech)),
    sum(is.na(solar_pv))
  )
)

print(comparison)
```
